$comment: Toolkit settings (no secrets). run_root: where every SEO run and the shared data cache live — `~` is the user's home; an absolute path is used as is (outside the repo: nothing can be committed); a relative path is from the repo root and must be git-ignored (orchestrate.py refuses otherwise). cadence_days: how often each report should be refreshed; seo-brief flags reports older than this. retention_days: runs and cache entries older than this are deleted by `python3 seo/runs.py prune` or `python3 seo/pipeline.py --prune` (nothing prunes automatically).
